page_title: TOR 0-2 BOL | Torino v Bologna 21/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Samuele Ricci (Torino) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90+5' The free kick is delivered by Samuele Ricci (Torino) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.

90+4' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marco Piccinini blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick has been awarded to Torino.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Jens Odgaard makes his way off the pitch and Nicolo Casale (Bologna) comes on as his replacement.
85' Remo Freuler (Bologna) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.

83' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Marco Piccinini to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Bologna players can finally celebrate. Goal! Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 0:2.
81' Wait! Referee Marco Piccinini immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
81' A goal, which was scored by Tommaso Pobega (Bologna), was disallowed due to offside.
79' Here is a change. Juan Miranda is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna).
78' Substitution. Yann Karamoh walks off the pitch and Alieu Njie (Torino) comes on as a substitute.
77' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Federico Ravaglia intercepts the ball.
77' Ivan Ilic (Torino) takes the corner with a short pass.
77' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Yann Karamoh (Torino). The linesman points to the corner flag, Torino are going to take it.
77' The players claim that Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
74' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Juan Miranda (Bologna).
74' 6:7 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 0:4.

71' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Juan Miranda plays the ball to the feet of Thijs Dallinga (Bologna), who hits a tremendous first-time shot into the top left corner. The goalkeeper was unable to keep it out. 0:1.
70' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Santiago Castro is replaced by Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
70' Che Adams (Torino) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Mergim Vojvoda. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
70' Samuele Ricci (Torino) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
70' Ivan Ilic (Torino) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
68' Che Adams (Torino) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
67' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Remo Freuler (Bologna). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
65' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to gather the ball.
64' Today's match ends for Karol Linetty who will be replaced by Ivan Ilic (Torino).
63' Substitution. Antonio Sanabria leaves the pitch and is replaced by Che Adams (Torino).
63' Paolo Vanoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nikola Vlasic (Torino) replacing Gvidas Gineitis.
61' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) gets into a shooting position! What a long-range cannonball of a shot! His nice effort, however, only crashes against the crossbar. Aim better, sir.
61' Santiago Castro (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

60' Chance! Remo Freuler sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Santiago Castro (Bologna), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
58' Remo Freuler (Bologna) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
56' Santiago Castro (Bologna) is penalised for a foul. Marco Piccinini had a clear view and blows his whistle.
55' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) commits a foul during an attacking move.
50' Neat link-up play between Yann Karamoh (Torino) and Antonio Sanabria, but Federico Ravaglia reads the game well and the move breaks down.
46' Vincenzo Italiano makes a switch. Giovanni Fabbian is coming on in place of Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) at the start of the second period.
46' The game is over for Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna). Riccardo Orsolini comes on for the second half.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
45+2' Borna Sosa (Torino) serves up a nice cross, but Federico Ravaglia punches the ball away.
45+2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Marcus Pedersen (Torino).
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' Yann Karamoh (Torino) dribbles into the box, but Federico Ravaglia is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
44' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul after Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) hacks down one of his opponents.
41' 3:2 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 0:2.
38' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Marcus Pedersen (Torino) offside.
37' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
35' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) replaces Sebastian Walukiewicz.
34' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
32' The game is interrupted now, Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
31' Santiago Castro (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
30' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
28' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
26' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Borna Sosa (Torino), but his powerful first-time shot flies well wide of the right post.
26' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Marco Piccinini stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
25' Borna Sosa (Torino) is able to continue to play.
24' Looks like Borna Sosa (Torino) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
21' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.

21' Adam Masina (Torino) latches onto a precise cross from the free kick and produces a header at goal from the penalty spot, but his attempt towards the roof of the net fails to beat Federico Ravaglia, who makes a fine save.

20' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Torino win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
19' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) trips an opposition player and Marco Piccinini signals a foul.
18' Yann Karamoh (Torino) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Federico Ravaglia, who smothers the ball.
16' A pass by Juan Miranda (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
14' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle and signals a foul after Karol Linetty (Torino) brought his opponent down.
12' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) takes the corner which is cleared.
11' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Marco Piccinini who sees an offensive foul.

8' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target.
8' Penalty saved! Santiago Castro (Bologna) sends the penalty towards the left hand side of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
8' Santiago Castro (Bologna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
8' It’s a PENALTY to Bologna after the VAR review!
7' There's a break in play and referee Marco Piccinini must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bologna using VAR. This could be interesting!
6' One of the Bologna players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
5' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
4' Wonderful pass from Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) for Yann Karamoh, but they can't profit from it as Federico Ravaglia comes off his line to collect.
2' Yann Karamoh (Torino) does well to meet the corner from Marcus Pedersen, but his close-range header is soft and goes miles wide of the right post.
2' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) prepares to take a corner kick.
1' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play. Torino win a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Torino will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Marco Piccinini.
